content: Do we build our own feature-flag service or buy one?
Buy Unleash self-hosted. Building our own delayed the last two launches. Budget is $400/month.
LaunchDarkly is 8x the cost at our seat count. Unleash self-hosted is the call.
Decision: Unleash self-hosted for feature flags, not LaunchDarkly, not a homegrown service.
I'll provision the Unleash Postgres and wire the SDK this week.
